Then SYNC(topbar) and set the description
helperNotes: P(varId) seeds a bound paint with the colour resolved in the Style components frame context (Liquid Light) and sets paint.opacity to the variable's alpha

T(text, role, colourVar): roles body/strong/small/caption/label/heading/title bind type/* vars; emph = body size/line/tracking + literal Semi Bold (fontStyle unbound); medium = the same in Medium; row/rowsemi = literal 14/18 −0.4%; upper = type/label + UPPER + 2%
G(instance, colourVar, size) recolours glyph vectors (and resizes the instance); SL/FR toggle state-layer/focus-ring (opacity 1, radius) and skip boolean-bound layers
